prompt: Ben stacks 'after I make morning coffee, I will write for 10 minutes', but he only makes coffee at home on weekends, so weekday writing rarely happens. What is the flaw?

options.text: Ten minutes is too short for a stacked habit
Coffee is a reward, so it can never be a cue
Writing should be stacked onto three habits at once
The anchor habit does not happen on the days the new habit is meant to happen, so the cue is missing on weekdays

explanation: Habit stacking only works if the anchor is stable and frequent on the target days. Anchoring to something he does every weekday, such as after breakfast, fixes the missing cue.
